title: Monthly server patch compliance export
description: Keep a monthly export or screenshot proving production servers were reviewed for missing patches and remediated.
collectionMethod: Export Atera or patch dashboard results, capture the review date, and link any remediation ticket numbers in the evidence description.

title: Weekly security log review summary
description: Retain a recent summary showing identified security events were reviewed and closed or escalated.
collectionMethod: Upload a ticket/export showing reviewed security events, owner, disposition, and closure date.

title: Quarterly log retention and storage settings proof
description: Document where logs are stored, how long they are retained, and that retention settings remain enabled.
collectionMethod: Capture screenshots or exports of log storage destinations and retention policies for each production logging source.

title: Monthly anti-malware management proof
description: Show anti-malware is centrally managed and active on covered endpoints and servers.
collectionMethod: Export or screenshot the Windows Defender / Atera management view showing policy, update status, and device coverage.

title: Monthly vulnerability scan report and remediation summary
description: Keep the latest scan output plus evidence that critical findings were assigned and tracked.
collectionMethod: Upload the scan report and a second file or description tying critical findings to tickets or mitigations.

title: Monthly production change-ticket population and review
description: Retain the complete production change-ticket population, including automated Linux package-change tickets, and document management review of authorization, validation, exceptions, and closure.
collectionMethod: Refresh the RRS Tickets Change Population export, sample PATCHAGENT and other production-change tickets, and record approval/testing/rollback/closure review. RRS-000125 is the first validated automated package-change sample.
